branches.compatible_interpretation: Benefit is consistent with useful target retention under modest conflicting reference pressure.
required_checks: target protection was realized rather than merely requested
admission denial and quota saturation are low
whole-decode effect is reconciled with protected coverage
D1_D2 and D2_D3 consistency is reported
branches.must_not_claim: Low proxy pressure proves absence of real L2 conflict or eviction.

branches.compatible_interpretation: Target-local benefit may be real but offset by collateral cache/admission cost or limited protected coverage.
required_checks: inspect non-target slowdown and denial counters
check whether global quota is sufficient but placement is unfavorable
branches.must_not_claim: A local positive result implies a net application benefit.

branches.compatible_interpretation: The budget or admission policy may be failing to realize intended protection; timing is not a clean test of retained-target usefulness.
required_checks: target request eligibility and fill realization
distinguish global capacity shortage from local placement pressure
branches.must_not_claim: A weak timing result disproves reuse value.

branches.compatible_interpretation: Retention may be realized but not timing-critical, reused too late, hidden by another bottleneck, or offset by collateral effects.
required_checks: reuse distance and next-reuse referenced target footprint
target hit-path or service-time evidence from the future timing run
branches.must_not_claim: High protection with no speedup proves the pressure proxy or mapper is wrong.
